title: Task Manager
subtitle: Tree-based Task Management with Merkle Verification
description: A powerful task management library with tree structure, pause/resume capability, IndexedDB persistence, and cryptographic verification via Merkle trees.

features.title: Features
features.tree_structure: Tree-based task hierarchy with parent-child relationships
features.pause_resume: Pause, resume, and cancel tasks at any time
features.persistence: IndexedDB persistence with split storage for efficiency
features.merkle_tree: Merkle tree support for cryptographic verification
features.svelte_store: Svelte 5 reactive store with derived values
features.type_safe: Full TypeScript support with strict types

basic.title: 1. Parallel Execution
basic.description: Execute multiple tasks in parallel with configurable concurrency

lifecycle.title: 2. Task Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Control task execution with pause, resume, and cancel

batch.title: 3. Batch Processing
batch.description: Process multiple items with progress tracking

merkle.title: 4. Merkle Verification
merkle.description: Generate and verify Merkle proofs for task integrity

multi_tab.title: Multi-Tab Coordination
multi_tab.description: Prevents data corruption when multiple browser tabs access the same database using Web Locks API
multi_tab.step1: Open this page in 2 or more browser tabs
multi_tab.step2: Click "Heavy Write" in Tab A to start a long operation
multi_tab.step3: Quickly switch to Tab B and click "Create Task (Safe)"
multi_tab.step4: Observe that Tab B waits for Tab A to release the lock
multi_tab.heavy_started: Starting heavy write (will hold lock for 3s)...
